summary: Two-valued mode/flag setter on the word at this+0xEC. If a2 is 4096, the word is rewritten with the two mode bits cleared (via mask 0xFFFFCFFF) and bit 0x1000 set. If a2 is 0x2000, the word is rewritten with the two mode bits cleared (via mask 0xFFFFCFFF) and bit 0x2000 set, and that new word becomes the return value. For any other a2 the field is untouched and a2 is returned.

local_names.this: object owning the mode word at +0xEC
local_names.a2: selector literal selecting which of the two mode bits to set

operations.description: result initialized to a2, the selector value
Branch on a2 == 4096 selecting the 0x1000 mode bit
this[59] (this+0xEC) cleared of the two mode bits via mask 0xFFFFCFFF and set to 0x1000
Alternate branch on a2 == 0x2000 selecting the 0x2000 mode bit
this[59] (this+0xEC) cleared of the two mode bits via mask 0xFFFFCFFF and set to 0x2000; result becomes the rewritten word
Return result: a2 for the 4096 branch and other values, or the rewritten field word for the 0x2000 branch
